name: MPC Sample Scale Mode
author: jacob-sabella
summary: Hold 16 Levels on the MPC Sample to play its 16 slots in a scale (8 scales, any root), starting from the sample's own note (MPC's, or heard in the audio when untagged). A SCALE page shows the notes and lights the one you play. Recorded hits keep their notes. Needs the MPC Sample Draw Handler for the page.
